name: GeoMap
description:
A MapLibre map of status points, framed on a home region, with clustered markers coloured by
worst status, hover and pinned popups, keyboard navigation between markers and an optional
list view in the same box. It shows the region silhouette while loading.
signature: <T>({ label, config, home, regions, points, loading, frame: frameProp, frameKey, selectedId: selectedIdProp, defaultSelectedId, onSelectedIdChange, renderPopup, renderClusterPopup, pulses, statusLabels, noun, view, onViewChange, list, insets, className, }: GeoMapProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: config
props.description: Typed component configuration and external provider definitions.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The point selected at first when the selection is uncontrolled.

props.name: frame
props.description: Frame the home region (default) or the points.

props.name: frameKey
props.description: Re-frame when this changes (a new scope, a new home region).

props.name: home
props.description: The home region: undefined while it loads, null when there is none.

props.name: insets
props.description:
Page chrome floating over a full-bleed map, in CSS pixels (a header above, a status strip
below): controls, credits and every frame stay clear of it, and it re-frames when it
changes. `null` means "being measured": the silhouette stays transparent until the insets
are known, so a server-rendered frame never paints in the wrong place and then jumps (CLS).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the map: "Sites, All organisations".

props.name: list
props.description: The list view: the caller's table, with a ViewToggle in its toolbar.

props.name: loading
props.description: The points are still loading: the silhouette stays, markers wait.

props.name: noun
props.description: Singular and plural names used in counts and accessible labels.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: ((id: string | null, details: SelectionChangeDetails<MapPoint<T>>) => void) | undefined
props.description:
Called with the id of the point whose popup the person pins (a click, Enter or Space on
its marker, or choosing it from a cluster popup or the off-screen list), and details
whose `item` is the point. Hover and focus previews, and pinning the point already
selected, do not call it.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view the person asks for ("list" or "map") from the view toggle, or "list" from the failure notice when the map cannot start. The toggle shows only when this is set. Pair with `view`.

props.name: points
props.description: Geographical or chart points.

props.name: pulses
props.description: Per point, a counter that changes when its status changes: the marker pulses once.

props.name: regions
props.description: Other regions to outline faintly (the regions that hold points). Defaults to an empty list.

props.name: renderClusterPopup
props.description: Renders details for an aggregate map cluster.

props.name: renderPopup
props.description: Renders details for an individual map point.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected point's id, or null for none. Controlled while defined; leave it undefined to use `defaultSelectedId`.

props.name: statusLabels
props.description: Display and accessible labels for the supported statuses.

props.name: view
props.description: "map" (default) or "list": the list replaces the map in the same box.
